articles.title: The Plaza Hotel, which Donald Trump drove into bankruptcy and sold at an $83 million loss in 1995, to shut its doors until 2031
articles.description: The iconic Plaza Hotel in New York City will undergo a major restoration, with closures planned from January 2027 to 2031. Fairmont Hotels & Resorts announced this initiative to preserve its historic façade, reflecting the hotel's deep architectural significance and cultural heritage. As a beloved landmark frequently featured in films, the Plaza has evolved through various ownerships in its 119-year legacy, underscoring its integral role in New York's identity.
